name: gosdk
description: Go development toolkit for github.com/bizshuk/gosdk — bundles 2 Go-focused skills (dev, review) and the assertive `golang-refactor` agent that auto-invokes them to rewrite code breaking SOLID, MVC, naming, error handling, context propagation, or performance conventions. Triggers: refactor, review, audit, clean up, restructure, improve, profile memory, build a bubbletea TUI.
